listing.name: Thog's Domain  - More Explorarium Drones
listing.summary: Adds 29 new explorarium drone ships, seven fighter wings, and four weapons to the game.
listing.aiSummary: Adds 29 new explorarium drone ships, seven fighter wings, and four weapons to the game.

description:
Have All The Domain Drones+, but still want MORE domain drones? Want to fight a comically large, multi-part drone ship designed by an AI with pulsar-induced alzheimers? Or maybe you want the exact opposite - a tiny, multi-part miniwall to bolster your own Explorarium-themed fleet? Or possibly logistics drones, to fuel your green horde as they rampage across the stars?

Then you've come to the right place.

GET IT HERE:https://github.com/caninmyham/THG-Domain/releases/download/RELEASE7/Thogs.Domain.zip

STILL HAVE DOUBTS? JUST LOOK AT THESE GLOWING ENDORSEMENTS FROM COMPLETE STRANGERS:

"i linked your mod elsewhere and one of my friends looked at it, said, "its like im looking at a eviserated corpse but its starship parts" and then approved of it."

"I pretty much have a Spot for two Pickles permanently in my fleet ... that sounds weird writing this."

Currently, the mod adds a total of 29 different new explorarium drone ships, along with seven fighter wings and four "new" weapons. In the future, I plan to change the way the Leper is encountered by implementing a Magiclib mission - but for now, it can be (rarely) encountered anywhere you may find a Guardian, be it in orbit around Cryosleepers, or in gargantuan raid fleets added by mods.

As is, this mod does not add any particular way to aquire Explorarium blueprints in bulk nor does it increase the scenarios in which you may encounter them, so I highly reccomend taking another mod which either adds blueprint packages for domain drones, or makes them spawn as raiding parties if you hope to encounter them with greater frequency.

This is my first mod, so feedback is both highly appreciated and necessary for any further refinement to come forth. Although I have attempted to balance things to roughly vanilla standards - with some small exceptions made in order to increase the difficulty the player may face against Derelict fleets, especially in the instance of "Boss" ships such as the Leper, I am a sub-gamma core human and as such, I often times make mistakes.
